# OneGlanse

> Free, open-source AI visibility tracking for marketing teams.

OneGlanse collects responses from the user-facing interfaces of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overview through browser automation. Provider collection does not use model APIs. A separately configured model endpoint analyzes captured responses afterward.
